_doc: Declarative parameters for cw01-e07. Every number here is fixed by PREREGISTRATION.md; the world module reads this file and never hardcodes a threshold.

world._latent: Q_r: attempt-stable random orthogonal dxd per replicate world (QR of a Gaussian, signs fixed); theta drawn once per lifetime; observations and queries per episode

damage.selector: k distinct cell indices uniformly at random; inputs (K, k, rng) only
damage.sham: identical selector and draws; write M[i] <- M[i]; must be bit-identical to intact

evolution._amendment_2: lifetimes_per_eval 2 -> 8 is the ONE correction after the first gate refusal (PREREGISTRATION Amendment 2, CW01-D059). No other value changed.
evolution._matching: task stream keyed (attempt, r, 'train', generation) identical across arms and lineages; weather stream keyed (attempt, r, 'weather|train', generation) consumed identically by WEATHER and SHAMWEATHER; evolution stream keyed per lineage

rows._status_vocabulary: record (WEATHER), control (STATIC, SHAMWEATHER); fixed by primordial.fabric.envelope.ROW_STATUSES
